reusable_obstruction.statement: A finite-I no-recrossing route must supply a source-valid signed/correlated trajectory coordinate; unsigned A,C,D,E magnitudes and pressure localization alone do not orient localized energy transfer.
reusable_obstruction.scope: whole-space 3D NSE Type-I research routing; local representation obstruction only

lesson_proposal.statement: When a localized energy argument needs a one-sided law, separate signed flux/orientation from magnitude control before attempting scale summation or pressure-tail estimates.
